title: Anthropic halka arz sonrasi yuksek riskli yatirim notu alabilir
summary: Financial Times haberine gore, halka arz surecine giren Anthropic sirketinin kredi derecelendirme kuruluslarindan yuksek riskli junk notu almasi bekleniyor.
body:
Anthropic halka arz sonrasi yuksek riskli yatirim notu alma ihtimaliyle karsilasabilir. TechCrunch'in aktardigina gore, Financial Times tarafindan yayimlanan bir rapor, Claude modellerinin gelistiricisi Anthropic'in halka arzinin ardindan kredi derecelendirme kuruluslarindan speküler veya yuksek riskli olarak tanimlanan junk derecesi alacagini öngörüyor.

## Blackstone beklentisini degistirdi

Anthropic'in çip finansmani icin gerceklestirilen 63 milyar dolarlik anlasmanin capasi konumundaki yatirim devleri arasinda yer alan Blackstone, daha once sirketin 2027 yilindan once yatirim yapilabilir duzeyde bir derecelendirme alacagini savunuyordu. Ancak yeni raporda Blackstone yatirimcilara, sirketin halka arz sonrasi cift B araliginda bir not almasini bekledigini aktardi. Bu seviye, speküler yatirim derecelerinin en ust basamagini olusturuyor. Anthropic ve Blackstone taraflari ise yapilan haber ve iddialarla ilgili yorum yapmaktan kacindi.

## Finansman maliyetleri uzerindeki olasi etkiler

Blackstone tarafindan yapilan bu tahmin henuz bir onguru niteligi tasiyor. Bununla birlikte, olasi bir yuksek riskli derecelendirme, sirketin buyuk harcamalarini finanse etmek icin borclanma maliyetlerini artirabilir ve sureci zorlastirabilir. Sirketin son bir yil boyunca devasa islem gucu anlasmalari imzalamasi yatirimcilarin endiselenmesine yol acarken, Anthropic haftanin basinda resmi olarak halka arz basvurusunda bulunmustu.

**Neden önemli?** Kredi derecelendirme kuruluslarindan gelebilecek yuksek riskli junk notu beklentisi, Anthropic'in yogun harcama temposunu surdurmek icin basvuracagi borclanma sureclerini daha maliyetli hale getirebilir.
editor_note: Haber Financial Times raporuna ve Blackstone'un yatirimcilara ilettigi tahminlere dayanmaktadir.

source_texts.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, report says
source_texts.summary: The new report says the AI lab will likely qualify for a high junk rating.
source_texts.text:
Anthropic is expected to receive a high “junk” rating from credit rating agencies following its initial public offering, according to a report from the Financial Times.
The FT says the investment giant Blackstone, the investment giant and anchor investor in a recent $63 billion deal to finance Anthropic’s chips, told investors in the deal that it expects the AI lab to receive a “high” junk rating after its IPO. Previously, the FT notes, Blackstone had said the opposite: that the Claude-maker would receive an investment-grade rating (indicating low risk for lenders) before 2027 rolls around.
Now, Blackstone expects double B range rating, the top tier of speculative “junk” grade, according to the reporting.
TechCrunch reached out to Anthropic and Blackstone but both declined to comment.
Blackstone’s forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business. The lab has been on a spending spree, wracking up large compute power deals throughout the past 12 months, which has worried investors.
Anthropic officially filed to go public earlier this week, kicking off a wave of speculation about how the massive IPO would impact the broader AI industry.
